entry.name: mc.gain~
entry.description: The mc.gain~ object is a slider that scales multichannel signals. It can also make a smooth transition as you move from one value of the slider to the next.

attributes.name: multislider
attributes.digest: Multiple Sliders
attributes.description: Ifis enabled, theobject will create a slider for each channel in its input multichannel signal, permitting independent level control of each channel. If the object is not wide or tall enough to show all the sliders, it remains in single slider mode until its size is adjusted.

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.digest: Sets the orientation of the slider.

choices.label: In automatic mode (the default for bothand), the longest side of the slider's rectangle determines the orientation.
The slider maintains a horizontal orientation regardless of the shape of its rectangle.
The slider maintains a vertical orientation regardless of the shape of its rectangle.

attributes.name: param_connect
attributes.digest: Connect to Parameter
attributes.description: Establishes a two-way connection between the object and a parameter of a compatible object with parameters such asor. The object can be used to change the value of the parameter and will update if the parameter value changes. The easiest way to setis with the attribute's menu in theor the Connect submenu of the. The menu displays all available parameters of compatible objects.Setting theattribute with a message requires the target parameter's path, which is the host object's scriping name followed by two colons and the parameter name. For example, for aobject with scripting name, the path of theparameter would be. You can set a value for thebefore the host object or parameter exists, and the object will connect to the parameter once it exists. Refer to the user guide entry forfor more details.

messages.name: (mouse)
messages.digest: Click and drag to set the slider outlet
messages.description: Clicking and dragging with the mouse sets the value of the slider, ramps the output signal to the level corresponding to the new value over the specified ramp time, and outputs the slider’s value out the right outlet.

messages.name: bang
messages.digest: Send current slider value out right outlet
messages.description: Sends current slider value out right outlet.

messages.name: color
messages.description: Sets theto a legacy color (from the 1990s) by index 0 - 15.

messages.name: float
messages.digest: Set a new audio gain/output value
messages.description: In left inlet: Converted to. Sets the value of the slider, ramps the output signal to the level corresponding to the new value over the specified ramp time, and outputs the slider's value out the right outlet.

messages.name: ft1
messages.description: In right inlet: Sets the ramp time in milliseconds. The default is 10 milliseconds.

messages.name: int
messages.digest: Set a new audio gain/output value
messages.description: In left inlet: Sets the value of the slider, ramps the output signal to the level corresponding to the new value over the specified ramp time, and outputs the slider's value out the right outlet.

messages.name: list
messages.description: The object takesmessages in conjunction withobjects.

messages.name: set
messages.digest: Set a new gain; output audio without outputting slider value
messages.description: In left inlet: The word, followed by a number, sets the value of the slider, ramps the output signal to the level corresponding to the new value over the specified ramp time, but does not output the slider's value out the right outlet.

messages.name: signal
messages.digest: Input multichannel signal to be scaled by the slider
messages.description: In left inlet: The input multichannel signal to be scaled by the slider.
